database_url_log_detection.artifact: Fix false positive in database connection string log detection
database_url_log_detection.note: Test detects 'DATABASE_URL' in error messages like logger.error('DATABASE_URL not set'). These are not actual connection strings - they're missing-config warnings. Fix: update test regex to exclude 'not set' patterns, or refactor log messages.

data_architecture.description: Schema and infrastructure for multi-corpus querying

federal_programs_vector_embeddings.description: Add federal programs to pgvector corpus for semantic search
federal_programs_vector_embeddings.notes: Enable queries like 'what federal housing money is available?' to find CDBG, HOME, Section 8 info. Include both national program descriptions and jurisdiction-specific allocations.
federal_programs_vector_embeddings.artifact: Vector embeddings for federal_programs corpus type

entity_type_definitions.description: Define dataclasses for remaining untyped entities: ExecutiveOrder, Legislation, ElectedOfficial, MunicipalCodeSection
entity_type_definitions.notes: Follow-on to civic_type_extraction. These entities are currently raw dicts from storage. Proper types improve IDE support, validation, and API consistency. Do incrementally as each area is touched.

hud_exchange_parser.description: Create HUD Exchange / HUD CPD allocation data client
hud_exchange_parser.notes: Downloads official HUD Excel spreadsheets (FY2020-2025) for CDBG/HOME/ESG/HOPWA/HTF/RHP allocations. Note: San Rafael receives HUD formula funds via Marin County consortium, not as direct entitlement. See docs/FEDERAL_PROGRAMS_PARSER_STRATEGY.md.

sam_assistance_client.description: Create SAM.gov Assistance Listings API client
sam_assistance_client.notes: Replace Perplexity-sourced program definitions with authoritative SAM.gov data. REST API via open.gsa.gov/api/. Free API key from api.data.gov. Provides program eligibility, compliance requirements, ALN (CFDA) numbers. See docs/FEDERAL_PROGRAMS_PARSER_STRATEGY.md.

federal_programs_expand_catalog.description: Expand federal program catalog with ESG, HOPWA, HTF, CoC, transportation, and EPA programs
federal_programs_expand_catalog.notes: Session 513: Added 12 new programs. Housing: ESG, HOPWA, HTF, CoC. Transportation: CMAQ, STBG, Section 5310, RAISE. Environment: CWSRF, DWSRF, Brownfields, Clean School Bus. Total: 22 programs in PostgreSQL + pgvector. Semantic search verified working.
federal_programs_expand_catalog.artifact: 22 federal programs in federal_programs table, 22 embeddings in pgvector

san_rafael_allocations_ingest.description: Ingest San Rafael historical federal program allocations from HUD Exchange
san_rafael_allocations_ingest.notes: Use HUDExchangeClient to retrieve San Rafael CDBG/HOME/ESG allocations for FY2020-FY2025. Store in federal_program_allocations table. Enables 'what federal money is available?' queries with real amounts.
san_rafael_allocations_ingest.artifact: San Rafael allocations in federal_program_allocations table with vector embeddings

manual_input_fallback_schema.artifact: Schema for manually-curated financial mappings when automation fails
manual_input_fallback_schema.note: Some mappings (e.g., grant-to-program, CFDA enrichment) require human input. Define data/manual/*.json schema with source attribution and last_updated tracking. Prioritize automation but plan for manual fallback.
manual_input_fallback_schema.pattern: Manual input should be structured, versioned, and clearly marked as human-curated

marin_county_financial_config.artifact: Create data/extraction/marin-county.json with financial data sources
marin_county_financial_config.note: County-level budget context. SCO data available. Identify budget/ACFR PDF locations.

_completed_items.note: Reduced pilot.json from 183KB to 57KB (69% reduction), preserving all tracking capability

executive_orders_vector_embeddings.artifact: Vector embeddings for executive order RAG queries
executive_orders_vector_embeddings.note: Session 491: 1,506 EOs ingested to SQL (executive_orders table) but not vectorized. Embed: EO titles, summaries, full text. Enables queries like 'executive orders about immigration' or 'Trump EOs affecting trade'. Lower priority than elections since EOs are federal-level context.

srcs_transcript_pipeline.artifact: Transcribe SRCS board meetings and index for RAG
srcs_transcript_pipeline.note: After YouTube integration, extend existing transcription pipeline (AssemblyAI) to school board meetings. Enables what_was_said() queries across both city and school governance.

srcs_decision_extraction.artifact: Extract decisions/votes from SRCS meeting minutes using LLM
srcs_decision_extraction.note: After agenda items, extract decisions from minutes PDFs (if available). Same pattern as city: civic_extraction.cli.decisions with Gemini. Populates decisions table. Lower priority - minutes often lag behind meetings.

advisory_committee_transcripts.artifact: Extend transcript coverage to PAAC and other advisory committees
advisory_committee_transcripts.note: Session 499 audit: city-san-rafael has 115 meetings across 13 body types but only 19 city_council transcripts. Video discovery gap: videos table is empty, meetings.video_url not populated. Current transcripts were created by directly transcribing from YouTube playlist, bypassing discovery. Need to: (1) discover which bodies have YouTube recordings (check San Rafael YouTube channel @cityofsanrafael), (2) populate videos table or meetings.video_url, (3) run automated transcript pipeline. Priority bodies: PAAC (3 meetings), Planning Commission (13), Fire Commission (11).

cost_dashboard.artifact: Admin dashboard showing cumulative ETL costs by pipeline and time period
cost_dashboard.note: Aggregate from etl_costs table. Show daily/weekly/monthly breakdown by pipeline type.

cost_alerts.artifact: Alert when ETL costs exceed threshold ($5/day or $50/month)
cost_alerts.note: Prevent runaway costs from misconfigured pipelines or unexpected data volume.

global_rate_limit.artifact: Global API rate limit to prevent cost spikes from traffic surges
global_rate_limit.note: Simple slowapi limiter on API endpoints. No auth required. Set ceiling at 10x expected pilot traffic. Protects against viral spikes or bot traffic.

real_data_canary.artifact: Monthly CI workflow that validates external data sources haven't changed
real_data_canary.note: GitHub Actions workflow on monthly schedule. Downloads sample from each source (Legistar, SeeClickFix, San Rafael agendas), runs extraction, validates output structure. Creates GitHub Issue on failure. Not for ingestion - just validates APIs and formats haven't broken.

admin_operations.description: Operational tools for admin support and automation

api_key_status.artifact: Show API key status for AssemblyAI, LegiScan

federal_programs_scheduled_refresh.description: Automated periodic refresh of federal programs from SAM.gov
federal_programs_scheduled_refresh.artifact: Modal function or cron job that fetches updated program data from SAM.gov Assistance Listings API
federal_programs_scheduled_refresh.note: Currently federal programs are manually ingested via scripts/ingest_federal_programs.py. Data was last refreshed Oct 2025. Federal program details (eligible activities, compliance requirements) can change annually. Recommend quarterly refresh minimum.
options: Modal scheduled function (preferred - already have Modal infra)

auto_vector_indexing_on_ingest.artifact: Automatically trigger vector indexing when new corpus data is stored
auto_vector_indexing_on_ingest.note: Current gap: discover/ingest/store runs together but indexing is a separate weekly GitHub Actions job. New data can be stale for up to 7 days before vectors are built. Options: (1) Post-store callback in Pipeline class that triggers index_from_storage(), (2) Event-based trigger (Postgres NOTIFY/LISTEN or webhook), (3) Reduce weekly schedule to daily. Consider cost implications - indexing is compute-intensive.
auto_vector_indexing_on_ingest.gap_identified: Session investigating PAAC extraction found extraction runs but vectors lag by up to 7 days

federal_programs_vector_workflow.description: Add federal programs corpus to vector-refresh GitHub Actions workflow
federal_programs_vector_workflow.note: Session 513 added pgvector support for federal programs but it's not in the CI workflow. Currently only indexes: chunks, meetings, transcripts, municipal_code, issues, decisions. Federal programs vectors were indexed manually once but won't auto-refresh.
federal_programs_vector_workflow.gap_identified: Session 513 - federal_programs_vector_embeddings completed but not in CI

conditional_vector_reindex_after_ingest.description: Trigger vector re-indexing automatically after federal programs data refresh
conditional_vector_reindex_after_ingest.artifact: Post-ingest hook that calls pgvector.index_from_storage() for programs corpus when data changes
conditional_vector_reindex_after_ingest.note: Builds on auto_vector_indexing_on_ingest but specific to federal programs. When SAM.gov refresh completes, should automatically re-embed changed programs. Consider: only re-index programs with changed content (hash comparison) to minimize embedding API costs.

prepare_with_citations.description: When user prepares for a meeting, automatically search relevant: municipal code sections, state legislation, past decisions, similar issues. Include in preparation materials with proper citations.
prepare_with_citations.note: Session 489: Currently prepare() exists but doesn't leverage vector search. User should get 'Cite Cal. Gov. Code § 66314 for ADU rights' not just agenda context.

action_leverage_points.description: After retrieval, suggest concrete actions: 'State law preempts this denial - file appeal citing SB9', 'ESG grant deadline in 30 days - contact councilmember', '8 neighbors reported similar issue - start initiative'.
action_leverage_points.note: Session 489: Retrieval without action guidance is just research. Transform what_applies() results into actionable next steps.

document_generation.description: Generate: appeal letters (with legal citations), FOIA/CPRA requests (with specific record references), public comment drafts (with precedent citations), initiative descriptions (with neighbor context).

mcp_vector_search_tools.description: Add MCP tools: search_regulatory_stack (local+state+federal law), search_meeting_history (transcripts+decisions), find_similar_issues (whos_with_me for MCP). Enables RAG pattern: LLM reasons over retrieved context.
